property_summary: For any inputs where the recipients array has length == 1, the reference contract's transfer call always completes (does not revert) while the mutant (which requires length>1) will revert for some such inputs; we assert that calling transfer with a single-element recipient array succeeds on the reference.
change_summary: Change the initial require(_tos.length > 0) to require(_tos.length > 1) so calls with a single recipient now revert in mutant but succeed in original; for calls that pass, behavior may differ in return value only when single-element arrays are involved.
